# Meshcopia

> Free, original 3D models, tileable materials and texture atlases for humans and AI agents.
> Assets: CC-BY-4.0. Creator: Xenoah. Attribution required; commercial use allowed.

- Catalog: https://xenoah.github.io/meshcopia/api/catalog.json
- NDJSON: https://xenoah.github.io/meshcopia/api/catalog.ndjson
- Per-asset manifest: https://xenoah.github.io/meshcopia/api/assets/{id}.json
- Contribution instructions: https://github.com/Xenoah/meshcopia/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- Metadata schema: https://github.com/Xenoah/meshcopia/blob/main/docs/asset-schema.json
- Source: https://github.com/Xenoah/meshcopia
- License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Catalog schemaVersion: 2.1.0. assets[] contains id, type, title, titleEn, tags,
category, author, license, version, provenance, thumbnail, pageUrl, manifestUrl,
attribution, files[], downloads.full and (models only) downloads.models.
Models use publisher-verified downloads.delivery: archive is the ordinary FBX ZIP;
files is the exact FBX/required-texture consumer inventory, with one notice.
Missing delivery means FBX unavailable; do not silently select all-format archives.
Textures retain downloads.minimal (or a truthfully labeled legacy downloads.full).
The files[] at asset root are retained original/preview files, not the batch payload.
downloads.full/models/minimal keep their historical content, URLs and hashes.
Batch consumers use downloads.delivery.files and its verified chunk manifest.
Never assume GitHub Release links allow browser fetch. Keep direct Release hosts.
Every file and ZIP has bytes and sha256. Verify the downloaded bytes before use.
Keep LICENSE.txt from minimal ZIPs. For legacy ZIPs, keep both ATTRIBUTION.txt
and LICENSE.txt. Indicate any changes in your credits.
Models: Y-up unless metadata says otherwise; unit and dimensions are explicit.
Textures: width/height are exact pixel dimensions; resolution is the longest edge.
wrapMode applies to both axes: repeat, mirror, or clamp. seamless means continuity
under that declared mode. Mirror sources are NOT guaranteed seamless with repeat.
Clamp atlases have seamless:false and must not be tiled. UI previews match these
modes. Check maps; baseColor-only assets do not include normal/roughness/height maps.
Scalar roughness/metalness are preview material settings, not texture maps.
normalConvention applies only when maps.normal exists. Base color is sRGB.
Schema 2 adds rectangular and non-tileable textures; consumers of 1.0.0 must handle
wrapMode and dimensions before applying textures.
No authentication, POST endpoints, or server-side search. Filter the JSON locally.
Only public assets appear in the catalog. Drafts are never published.
